description: The two native capabilities the daemon's own served page gets, even though it is a remote origin (http://127.0.0.1) and not this app's own bundled frontend: the folder-picker dialog data/desktop.ts's pickFolder calls for New project, and opening an http(s), mailto or tel link in the system browser (platform/desktop.ts's openExternal), because this window has no new windows of its own. Nothing else reaches that origin - no command execution, no filesystem, no notifications, no updater - and only from the daemon's fixed loopback port.
